# Sealed Cavity

A hollow inside the part with no way out for the resin or powder trapped in it.

<figure markdown="span">
![Sealed Cavity: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/sealed-cavity-light.svg#only-light){ width="640" }
![Sealed Cavity: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/sealed-cavity-dark.svg#only-dark){ width="640" }
<figcaption>A hollow sealed inside the part, full of resin or powder.</figcaption>
</figure>

## Where it applies

| Process | Criticality |
| :-- | :-- |
| [Resin 3D Printing (SLA)](../../reference/processes/resin-3d-printing.md) | High |
| [Powder Bed Fusion (SLS)](../../reference/processes/powder-bed-fusion.md) | Medium |

## Values

This rule has no number to meet: when it finds the problem, it reports it as the error or warning set here.

=== "Resin 3D Printing (SLA)"

    Criticality in this process: **High** ([what this means](../../concepts/criticality.md)).

    | Material | If detected | Source |
    | :-- | :-- | :-- |
    | **Default** | Error | Published, [Formlabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#formlabs-sla "A sealed hollow traps resin and can blow out") |

    Every other material uses the Default values: Standard Resin, Tough / Durable Resin, Flexible / Elastic Resin.


=== "Powder Bed Fusion (SLS)"

    Criticality in this process: **Medium** ([what this means](../../concepts/criticality.md)).

    | Material | If detected | Source |
    | :-- | :-- | :-- |
    | **Default** | Warning | Published, [Raise3D](../../citations/bibliography.md#raise3d-sls "A warning, not an error: powder can be left in a sealed hollow on purpose") |

    Every other material uses the Default values: PA12 (SLS), PA12 (MJF), PA11, PA12 Carbon-filled, TPU.


## Messages

What the results panel says about a finding. You can rewrite these in the Process Library; the words in `{braces}` are filled in for each finding.

=== "Resin 3D Printing (SLA)"

    !!! warning "Warning"

        Sealed hollow: `{feature}` (`{size}`) is closed inside the part, so it prints full of liquid resin that can't drain. The resin can crack the part later, and the hollow can blow out while printing. Add two drain holes on opposite sides, or make it solid.
    !!! failure "Error"

        Sealed hollow: `{feature}` (`{size}`) is closed inside the part, so it prints full of liquid resin that can't drain. The resin can crack the part later, and the hollow can blow out while printing. Add two drain holes on opposite sides, or make it solid.

=== "Powder Bed Fusion (SLS)"

    !!! warning "Warning"

        Sealed hollow: `{feature}` (`{size}`) is closed inside the part, so it stays full of unfused powder: the part is heavier than it looks and the powder can rattle. Add two escape holes on opposite sides, or make it solid. Leaving it sealed is fine if you want the weight or damping.
    !!! failure "Error"

        Sealed hollow: `{feature}` (`{size}`) is closed inside the part, so it stays full of unfused powder. Add two escape holes on opposite sides, or make it solid.

| Placeholder | Replaced with |
| :-- | :-- |
| `{feature}` | What it is about, such as "Boss 3 (screw)" or "Face12" |
| `{size}` | Its size or what was found, such as "Ø3.00 mm and 9.00 mm deep" |
